proofs.text: Run `--check --project-root` against an empty directory and verify the return code is 2 and stderr contains `nothing to update`

rule_text: A project root with no `.purlin/` exits 2 saying there is nothing to update and naming the command that sets a project up

tests.body:
def test_a_root_without_purlin_exits_2(tmp_path, capsys):
    empty = str(tmp_path / 'empty')
    os.makedirs(empty)
    assert update.main(['--check', '--project-root', empty]) == 2
    assert 'nothing to update' in capsys.readouterr().err
tests.name: test_a_root_without_purlin_exits_2
